simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֲדָא (H5709) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 9 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֲדָא (ʻădâʼ) means alter, depart, pass (away), remove, take (away). First listed occurrence: Dan 2 21.

definitions.full: H5709. ada or adah [ עֲדָה ] verb pass on, away ( ᵑ7 (often for Hebrew עָבַר , Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew I. עָדָה (rare, late)); — Pe`al Perfect 3feminine singular עֲדָת Dan 3:27 ; 4:28 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יֶעְדֵּה 7:14 , 3 feminine singular תֶּעְדֵּה 6:9 ; — 1 pass on, over , with ב person Dan 3:27 . 2 pass way , of kingdom Dan 4:28 ( מִן person), 7:14 ; of law 6:9 . Haph`el take away (so Egyptian Aramaic S-C G 35 ): Perfect 3masculine plural הֶעְדִּיו , accusative of thing, Dan 5:20 ( מִן person), 7:12 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יְהַעְדּוּן 7:26 ; Participle מְהַעְדֵּה 2:21 remove, depose kings, of God.
